parent_company.value: Prism Johnson Limited - H & R Johnson (India) is its tile division, alongside Prism Cement and Prism RMC; Ardex Endura (India) is its tile-adhesive JV with the Ardex group of Germany

product_portfolio.value: Johnson ceramic wall and floor tiles, Porselano glazed vitrified tiles, Marbonite vitrified tiles and slabs, Endura industrial tiles, plus sanitaryware, bath fittings and engineered marble and quartz

market_coverage.value: Pan-India; the pioneer of ceramic tiles in India with over six decades of operation and the only Indian company offering end-to-end tiles, sanitaryware, bath fittings and engineered marble and quartz; over 3,000 options across company-owned experience centres including Hyderabad

quality_strength_note.value: Marbonite is the brand's fully vitrified flagship, and this Elite range is sold as a StainFree series - a low-maintenance polished surface; the Industrial Products and Natural Resources division has run its own ceramics R&D department (CTDC) since 1997

engineer_user_rating.value: 4.2/5 (typical) - engineers rate Johnson strongly on industrial and heavy-duty flooring, and as a solid rather than leading choice on decorative large formats

contractor_preference.value: Moderate to high. Contractors reach for Marbonite when a job needs a fully vitrified, easy-clean polished floor and the client already knows the Johnson name from ceramic tiles

novice_preference.value: High for ceramic wall tiles, moderate for large-format vitrified; first-time buyers recognise Johnson but often do not know Marbonite is the same house

project_vs_retail_cost_note.value: Project rates through the Prism Johnson institutional desk usually run 12-20% under the retail counter rate; retail carries dealer margin, freight and breakage allowance

bulk_discount_note.value: Discount slabs typically open around 500 sqft, improving at full-truck quantity; single-design loads price better than mixed loads

dealer_margin_note.value: Typical dealer margin 14-22% on vitrified tiles, thinner on hero designs held as stock lines

primary_use.value: Residential floor tiling in large format - living, dining and bedroom floors

secondary_use.value: Wall cladding and feature walls in the same module, and light-commercial interiors

special_use.value: Countertops, staircase treads and lift-lobby cladding; the wider Johnson range extends to industrial, anti-static, radiation-shielding and cool-roof tiles

short_description: Johnson Marbonite Elite Floral Crema, 600x1200 mm polished vitrified tile from the StainFree series, 2 tiles per box covering 1.44 sqm.
long_description:
## What it is

Floral Crema (article YK1FLCR000000PJ) is a polished vitrified tile from Elite DSF RT24, the 600 x 1200 mm collection of Marbonite by Johnson. Johnson describes the Marbonite StainFree series as fully vitrified and easy on maintenance; the tile is a dry-pressed porcelain body in a cream marble design, 9 mm thick.

## What it's for

Johnson lists the application as floor and wall, which is how the 2 x 4 ft format is used across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana - a continuous polished floor through living, dining and bedroom areas, with the same tile carried up a feature wall. PEI IV abrasion and a vitrified body cover domestic traffic and light-commercial interiors such as offices and showrooms. With an R9 slip class and a polished face this is an indoor, dry-area tile - not for balconies, terraces or open parking.

## Key specifications

The body is Group BIa vitrified porcelain with water absorption at or below 0.5%, the property behind both the stain tolerance and the dimensional stability a 1200 mm tile needs. Breaking strength is taken at 1300 N with a modulus of rupture of 35 N/mm², to IS 15622 and the ISO 10545 test series, surface hardness around MOHS 6 and stain resistance Class 5. Dimensional tolerance is held to 0.6%, so the rectified edge closes on a 2 mm joint. The StainFree surface is the range's own low-maintenance polished face.

## Application and installation notes

Fix thin-bed over a levelled, fully cured screed using a polymer-modified adhesive to IS 15477 - Ardex Endura, the group's own adhesive brand, is the matched product. Back-butter each tile so nothing is hollow across the 1200 mm span, hold joints at 2 mm, and check the box batch before laying, since shade variation is V2.

## What's in the box

One box holds 2 tiles covering 1.44 m² (about 15.5 sqft) and weighs about 31 kg. Sold by the box under HSN 6907 at 18% GST.
